transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

I’m here because ever since the foreclosure notices started coming, I feel like I’m falling apart. I’ve been crying in my truck before work, jumping every time the phone rings, snapping at the apprentices… and I’m making stupid mistakes in the repair bay that I never would’ve made before. It’s not like me.
Have you noticed feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or time with family?

Yeah… I have. I mean, I used to keep up with things outside work—church volunteering, fitness classes, truck-club outings. Lately I just don’t go. I don’t feel like being around people or doing any of it.

And at work, it’s gotten bad enough they took me out of the high-risk repair bay, which… that’s not normal for me.
Have you had any sudden episodes where you felt intense fear or discomfort that came out of nowhere, like your heart was racing, you couldn’t breathe, or you felt like you were losing control?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get really stressed and on edge, but I haven’t had an episode like that where it suddenly hits out of nowhere and I can’t breathe or feel like I’m losing control.
